positions.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer (Freelance)
description: Provisioned local development environment using Docker containers (PHP 8.1, MySQL), replicating production server specs for consistent dev/test parity.
Implemented Git branching strategy (feature → staging → production) enabling safe isolated deployments with full rollback capability.
Configured staging environment on shared Linux hosting (cPanel) using Git version control, subdomain creation, and DNS management via Cloudflare.
Diagnosed and resolved DNS propagation failure caused by external nameserver conflict between cPanel zone records and Cloudflare authoritative DNS, restoring service availability.

positions.title: Facility Operations Coordinator
description: Sole night-shift operative responsible for all operational activities across multiple zones, executing time-critical schedules from 20:00 to 05:00 with zero-failure handover to day shift.
Diagnosed and resolved operational equipment issues independently during night shift, identifying root causes and implementing solutions without escalation.
Maintained compliance documentation to client audit standards with zero failures across all inspection cycles.
Trained four new staff members on full site procedures including equipment operation, health and safety requirements, and compliance documentation.

positions.title: Founder & Infrastructure Engineer
description: Provisioned and managed full AWS infrastructure using Terraform including ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, ALB, Route 53, ACM, and ECR. All infrastructure defined as code with zero manual configuration.
Built and operated CI/CD pipeline with AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild, delivering zero-downtime container deployments to ECS on every release.
Configured Docker containerisation across all services, managing image builds, ECR pushes, and container orchestration on ECS Fargate.
Monitored production system health using CloudWatch dashboards and alarms, responding to and resolving infrastructure issues to maintain platform availability.

positions.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: Contributed to React/Node.js server-side applications supporting high-volume concurrent requests, maintaining stable system performance at production scale.
Assisted in optimising database indexing and RESTful API endpoints, contributing to measurable improvements in system response times.
Collaborated on implementing JWT authentication and data encryption standards across multiple services.
Supported automation of CI/CD pipelines, contributing to faster and more reliable deployment cycles.
